findings.evidence: public function listTransactions(int $page = 1, int $perPage = 50): array — when the caller omits perPage the handler applies a default of 50, but the specification documents "default": 25 for perPage. (The `if ($perPage < 1) { $perPage = 25; }` branch only applies to invalid values, not to omitted ones.) (verified: ASSERTION: spec documents a default of 25 for perPage; handler applied 50)
